title: Stephanie Grothe Hut
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: This hut was built in 2005 and sits at 1686 m on an exposed alpine ridge just south of Mt. Brew. It sleeps about 12 people comfortably, but it has fit as many as 20. The hut is open to non-motorized, non-commercial users.The Brew area receives huge amounts of snow in winter and is a popular destination for backcountry skiing.
